extraction.Name: Jacob Schweigman
extraction.Refused/Protested: No. not at the time of delivery, but before it was sent to me by mail I was at the agency and some one of the officials there, I do not remember for sure which one, offered me the patent and I would not take it. Then in about a week I received it by mail.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I sold it for $9000 in the form of 150 heifers valued at $60.00.
extraction.Fee Patent Date: some 12 years ago (approximately 1917, relative to 1929 document date)
extraction.NOTES: Received 150 heifers as payment; did not think he signed a receipt for the patent; received patent by mail; notary public is S. W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32; sworn March 25, 1929; satisfied with the sale of his land; did not make an application for the patent; has seven children, all of whom depend on him.
